description: Defines the CookieInclusionStatus class and related enums for managing cookie inclusion/exclusion reasons and warnings within the Chromium project. It includes methods for handling exclusion reasons, warnings, serialization, and debugging.

classes.name: net::CookieInclusionStatus
classes.description: Represents the inclusion/exclusion status of a cookie, including reasons for exclusion and warnings, with methods for managing and querying these reasons.

methods.name: GetDebugString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the exclusion reasons and warnings for debugging.

methods.name: HasExclusionReason
methods.description: Checks if a specific exclusion reason is present.

methods.name: HasWarningReason
methods.description: Checks if a specific warning reason is present.
